# Shazam

> Shazam is a music discovery platform for identifying songs, exploring artists and lyrics, tracking charts, and finding concerts.

Shazam helps users recognize music in seconds and browse song, artist, album, chart, radio spin, and event pages across regions. The site also provides app download information, editorial campaigns, and company and legal resources.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.shazam.com/): Main entry point for song discovery, charts, concerts, and app access.
- [Get the App](https://www.shazam.com/apps): Download Shazam and learn about supported platforms and app features.
- [Concerts](https://www.shazam.com/events/canada): Browse upcoming concerts and music events for Canada.
- [Top 200 Charts](https://www.shazam.com/charts/top-200/canada): View the current Top 200 Shazam chart for Canada.
- [Radio Spins](https://www.shazam.com/radiospins): Explore songs receiving radio airplay attention on Shazam.
- [Fast Forward '26](https://www.shazam.com/fastforward2026): Editorial or campaign page highlighting emerging music and artists.

## Charts
- [Canada Top 200](https://www.shazam.com/charts/top-200/canada): National Top 200 chart showing the most Shazamed tracks in Canada.
- [United States Top 200](https://www.shazam.com/charts/top-200/united-states): National Top 200 chart for the United States.
- [United Kingdom Top 200](https://www.shazam.com/charts/top-200/united-kingdom): National Top 200 chart for the United Kingdom.
- [Global Top 200](https://www.shazam.com/charts/top-200/worldwide): Worldwide Top 200 chart of trending tracks on Shazam.
- [Canada Viral Chart](https://www.shazam.com/charts/viral/canada): Viral chart page for fast-rising tracks in Canada.
- [Worldwide Viral Chart](https://www.shazam.com/charts/viral/worldwide): Global viral chart for rapidly emerging songs.

## Concerts & Events
- [Canada Events](https://www.shazam.com/events/canada): Discover concerts, live shows, and music events in Canada.
- [United States Events](https://www.shazam.com/events/united-states): Browse upcoming concerts and performances in the United States.
- [United Kingdom Events](https://www.shazam.com/events/united-kingdom): Find concerts and live music events in the United Kingdom.
- [Australia Events](https://www.shazam.com/events/australia): Explore concert listings and music events in Australia.

## Radio & Discovery
- [Radio Spins](https://www.shazam.com/radiospins): Track songs gaining momentum through radio airplay.
- [Top 200 Charts](https://www.shazam.com/charts/top-200/canada): Use chart rankings to discover popular songs in a region.
- [Viral Charts](https://www.shazam.com/charts/viral/worldwide): Find breakout tracks trending quickly across Shazam.
- [Fast Forward '26](https://www.shazam.com/fastforward2026): Discover featured artists and editorial music selections.

## App & Platforms
- [Get the App](https://www.shazam.com/apps): Download links and overview of the Shazam app experience.
- [Shazam on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/shazam/id284993459): iPhone and iPad app listing for Shazam.
- [Shazam on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shazam.android): Android app listing for Shazam on Google Play.
- [Apple Music](https://www.apple.com/apple-music/): Related Apple Music service for listening after discovering songs.
